description_en: Creates a time-based elastic plan. This operation applies only to Data Warehouse Edition clusters in elastic mode (new version)
description_zh: 调用CreateElasticPlan创建分时弹性计划。该接口仅适用于数仓版弹性模式集群版（新版）
name: CreateElasticPlan

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Data Warehouse Edition cluster.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html operation to query the IDs of all Data Warehouse Edition clusters in the specified region
parameters.help_zh:
数仓版集群ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html接口查看目标地域下所有数仓版集群的集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the elastic plan. Valid values:
The name must be 2 to 30 characters in length.
The name can contain uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, and underscores (_)
parameters.help_zh:
弹性计划名称。取值说明：
长度为2~30字符。
由大写字母、小写字母、数字或下划线（_）组成
parameters.name: elastic_plan_name

parameters.help_en:
The name of the resource group.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/466685.html operation to query the name of the resource group
parameters.help_zh:
资源组名称。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/466685.html接口查看资源组名称
parameters.name: resource_pool_name

parameters.help_en:
The number of nodes in the elastic plan.

If ElasticPlanType is set to worker, you can leave this parameter empty or set it to 0.

If ElasticPlanType is set to executorcombineworker or executor, you must set this parameter to a value greater than 0
parameters.help_zh:
弹性计划节点数。

当ElasticPlanType为worker时，该参数可以不填写或者填写0。

当ElasticPlanType为executorcombineworker或executor时，该参数必须填写大于0的数字
parameters.name: elastic_plan_node_num

parameters.help_en: The start time of the scale-out for the elastic plan. Only time frame settings are supported. Format: HH:mm:ss
parameters.help_zh: 弹性计划扩容时间，只支持设置整点时间。格式：HH:mm:ss
parameters.name: elastic_plan_time_start

parameters.help_en: The revert time of the elastic plan. Only time frame settings are supported. The interval between the scale-out time and the revert time cannot exceed 24 hours. Format: HH:mm:ss
parameters.help_zh: 弹性计划还原时间，只支持设置整点时间，与弹性计划扩容时间的间隔不能超过24小时。格式：HH:mm:ss
parameters.name: elastic_plan_time_end

parameters.help_en: The weekly recurrence of the elastic plan. Valid values: 0 to 6, which represent Sunday to Saturday. Separate multiple days with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 执行弹性计划的周期。0~6表示周日到周六，多个日期用半角逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: elastic_plan_weekly_repeat

parameters.help_en: The monthly recurrence of the elastic plan. The value represents the day of the month. Separate multiple days with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 执行弹性计划的周期。数字表示每个月的几号，多个日期用半角逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: elastic_plan_monthly_repeat

parameters.help_en: The start date of the elastic plan. Format: yyyy-MM-dd
parameters.help_zh: 弹性计划起始日期，格式：yyyy-MM-dd
parameters.name: elastic_plan_start_day

parameters.help_en: The end date of the elastic plan. Format: yyyy-MM-dd
parameters.help_zh: 弹性计划结束日期，格式：yyyy-MM-dd
parameters.name: elastic_plan_end_day

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the elastic plan takes effect. Valid values:

true (default): The elastic plan takes effect.

false: The elastic plan does not take effect
parameters.help_zh:
弹性计划是否生效，取值说明：

true（默认值）：生效。

false：不生效
parameters.name: elastic_plan_enable

parameters.help_en:
The resource type of the elastic plan. Valid values:

worker: Independent scaling of elastic I/O resources.
executor: Independent scaling of compute resources.
executorcombineworker (default): Joint scaling of compute and elastic I/O resources at the default ratio.

To use executorcombineworker, the cluster Milvus version must be 3.1.3.2 or later.
To use worker or executor, the cluster Milvus version must be 3.1.6.1 or later, and you must submit a ticket to apply for the feature. You can use worker or executor only after the application is approved
parameters.help_zh:
弹性计划资源类型，取值说明：

worker：弹性IO资源单独弹性。
executor：计算资源单独弹性。
executorcombineworker（默认值）：计算，弹性IO资源按默认比例弹性。

如果要使用executorcombineworker，集群内核版本需为3.1.3.2及以上版本。
如果要使用worker或executor，集群内核版本需为3.1.6.1及以上版本，且需要通过提交工单申请。申请通过后，才能使用worker或executor
parameters.name: elastic_plan_type

parameters.help_en:
The resource specification supported for scale-out in the elastic plan. Valid values:
8 cores, 64 GB (default)
16 cores, 64 GB
32 cores, 64 GB
64 cores, 128 GB
12 cores, 96 GB
24 cores, 96 GB
52 cores, 86 GB
parameters.help_zh:
弹性计划支持扩容的资源规格。取值说明：
8 Core 64 GB（默认规格）
16 Core 64 GB
32 Core 64 GB
64 Core 128 GB
12 Core 96 GB
24 Core 96 GB
52 Core 86 GB
parameters.name: elastic_plan_worker_spec
